name: Forgetting The Past
overview: Scripture calls believers to release the hold of past failures and distractions, urging them to 'not remember the former things' or 'consider the things of old' as God promises to blot out transgressions for His own sake. Jesus emphasizes the necessity of forward focus, warning that looking back disqualifies one from the kingdom of God. Believers are encouraged to live free from condemnation through Christ, offering themselves as living sacrifices and trusting in God's provision rather than anxious concern over life's necessities.
